situation.name: drug_use_italy_scenario_analysis
situation.description: Six-compartment model of illicit drug use trends in Italy with pure cannabis users and poly-drug users, each divided into occasional, regular, and intensive users. Includes health care compartment and susceptible source. Used for scenario analysis of policy interventions.

article.name: Drug user dynamics: A compartmental model of drug users for scenario analyses
article.author: Santoro, M., Triolo, L., Rossi, C.

compartments.name: cannabis_occasional
compartments.expression: dCo/dt = omega_Co*S0 + omega_o*Ao + phi_ro*Cr - Co*(phi_o + phi_ro + delta_Co + dCo)

compartments.name: other_occasional
compartments.expression: dAo/dt = omega_A*S0 + phi_o*Co + psi_ro*Ar - Ao*(omega_o + psi_or + delta_A + dAo)

compartments.name: cannabis_regular
compartments.expression: dCr/dt = omega_r*Ar + phi_or*Co + phi_ir*Ci - Cr*(phi_r + phi_ro + phi_ri + dCr)

compartments.name: other_regular
compartments.expression: dAr/dt = phi_r*Cr + psi_or*Ao + psi_ir*Ai - Ar*(omega_r + psi_ro + psi_ri + dAr)

compartments.name: cannabis_intensive
compartments.expression: dCi/dt = phi_ri*Cr + eta_Ci*H - Ci*(phi_ir + delta_Ci + dCi)

compartments.name: other_intensive
compartments.expression: dAi/dt = psi_ri*Ar + eta_Ai*H - Ai*(psi_ir + delta_Ai + dAi)

compartments.name: health_care
compartments.expression: dH/dt = delta_Ci*Ci + delta_Ai*Ai - H*(eta_Ci + eta_Ai + dH)
